mapper.select: SELECT id, partner_code, url_type, url, label, sort_order FROM collect_url WHERE partner_code = #{partnerCode} ORDER BY url_type, sort_order, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO partner_tab (partner_code, url, label, first_seen_on, last_seen_on) VALUES (#{partnerCode}, #{url}, #{label}, #{seenOn}, #{seenOn}) ON CONFLICT (partner_code, url) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE partner_tab SET label = #{label}, last_seen_on = #{seenOn} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crawl_job (partner_code, trigger, run_on) SELECT s.partner_code, 'SCHEDULE', #{runOn} FROM crawl_schedule s WHERE s.enabled AND (s.days = 'DAILY' OR (',' || s.days || ',') LIKE ('%,' || #{dow} || ',%')) AND s.run_time <= #{now} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collect_url c WHERE c.partner_code = s.partner_code) ON CONFLICT (partner_code, run_on) WHERE trigger = 'SCHEDULE' DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO crawl_job (partner_code, trigger, url_types, attempt, run_on, due_at, requested_by) VALUES (#{partnerCode}, #{trigger}, #{urlTypes,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}, #{attempt}, #{runOn}, now() + make_interval(mins => #{delayMinutes}), #{requestedBy})
mapper.select: UPDATE crawl_job SET status = 'RUNNING', started_at = now() WHERE id = ( SELECT j.id FROM crawl_job j WHERE j.status = 'QUEUED' AND j.due_at <= now() AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crawl_job r WHERE r.partner_code = j.partner_code AND r.status = 'RUNNING') ORDER BY j.due_at, j.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) RETURNING id, partner_code, trigger, array_to_string(url_types, '|') AS url_types, attempt, run_on
mapper.update: UPDATE crawl_job SET status = 'DONE', finished_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE crawl_job SET status = 'QUEUED', started_at = NULL WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND started_at < now() - make_interval(mins => #{olderThanMinutes})
mapper.select: INSERT INTO crawl_run (job_id, partner_code, url_type, run_on, result, url_count, collected_count, new_count, changed_count, ended_count, message, started_at) VALUES (#{jobId}, #{partnerCode}, #{urlType}, #{runOn}, #{result}, #{urlCount}, #{collectedCount}, #{newCount}, #{changedCount}, #{endedCount}, #{message}, #{startedAt}) RETURNING id
SELECT name FROM partner WHERE code = #{code}
SELECT collected_count FROM crawl_run WHERE partner_code = #{partnerCode} AND url_type = #{urlType} AND result = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY finished_at DESC LIMIT 1
